scheme_name: Haryana Merit Cum Means Scheme For Minority
other_conditions: Must belong to a notified minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi).
Must have scored at least 50% marks in the previous qualifying examination.
Must have secured admission to a professional or technical course in a recognized institution.
30% of scholarships are reserved for girl students, transferable to male students if no eligible girl candidates are available.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹30,000 per year for hostellers or ₹25,000 per year for day scholars, covering maintenance allowance and course fees.
